description: Write a Python module `intervals.py` containing a function `merge_intervals(items)` that takes a list of (start, end) tuples and returns the list of merged non-overlapping intervals, sorted by start. The input is NOT guaranteed to be sorted. The test file `test_intervals.py` is the authoritative spec — read it first to see every required edge case (empty, point intervals, touching intervals, containment, unsorted input).
